Crash.Title: Crash report drafts and destinations
Crash.Privacy: Local drafts only. Managed exceptions and unclean termination are different; an unclean session does not prove a native crash. Collection is best effort: power loss, native faults, full disks, or OS termination may leave nothing. No messages, stacks, logs, source paths or projects are collected. Review every field; automatic secret detection is incomplete. Only the checked text attachment is passed to the trusted provider DLL. DLLs are not sandboxed. Cancel keeps existing drafts but discards unsaved edits.
Crash.Provider: Destination provider (trusted extensions enabled in Settings)
Crash.SupportsText: Selected provider declares support for selected text (inline).
Crash.NoTextSupport: Selected provider does not declare support for text attachments.
Crash.Credential: Windows generic credential target (not a token)
Crash.CredentialHelp: Configure GitHub here for this window. First create a generic credential in Windows Credential Manager with this target and the token as password. No token is saved by LIBERA FX. Fine-grained tokens need repository Issues: write. Other OS secret stores and GitHub Enterprise are not implemented. Check destination performs an authenticated network request; it does not send the draft. External providers manage their own configuration.
Crash.Diagnostics: Optional diagnostics.txt content (editable, excluded by default)
Crash.Attach: Explicitly include diagnostics.txt exactly as previewed above
Crash.AttachmentLimits: One UTF-8 text attachment, at most 16,000 bytes. GitHub embeds the exact selected text in the issue body, not an uploaded file. Other providers must explicitly declare support. Redaction is incomplete: review every field before selecting and sending.
Crash.Redacted: Potentially sensitive lines were replaced. Review the entire preview; detection is incomplete. Select the attachment again to include it.
Crash.TextLoaded: Text loaded for review, not selected for sending. The original filename and path are not sent.
Crash.TextLoadFailed: Could not read the file as bounded UTF-8 text. The previous preview is unchanged.
Crash.DeleteConfirm: Permanently delete this local draft? This does not delete any remote report.
Crash.PermissionNotice: Authentication succeeded for lookup. Actual issue-write permission is only established by submission. Check the exact destination and visibility; no fallback is used.
Crash.Consent: I reviewed the title, body, selected attachment, exact destination and visibility. I consent to one send.
Crash.DuplicateConsent: If a previous attempt has an unknown outcome, I checked the tracker and accept that retrying may create a duplicate.
Crash.Send: Send once to the checked destination
Crash.Saved: Local edits saved. Check the destination again before sending.
Crash.Checked: Destination checked. Nothing sent. Review the fields and explicitly consent before sending.
Crash.NoDrafts: No recoverable drafts. Drafts are never synthesized from projects or logs.
Crash.StorageFailed: Local crash storage failed. Collection/recovery may be incomplete; no user settings or projects were changed.
Crash.CorruptDraft: Some crash data is invalid or too large. It was preserved unchanged and not sent. Remove invalid files manually from the isolated CrashDrafts directory if no longer needed.
Crash.InvalidReport: Title/body or selected text attachment is invalid or too large.
Crash.SensitiveText: Potential secret or local path found. Remove it from the preview before checking/sending. This check cannot detect all confidential information.
Crash.AttachmentsUnsupported: This provider does not declare support for selected text. Nothing was sent. Explicitly exclude it or choose a capable provider.
Crash.DestinationChanged: The destination or visibility changed. Nothing will be retried automatically. Check it again.
Crash.CredentialMissing: The configured OS credential is missing or invalid. No token fallback is used.
Crash.AuthenticationFailed: Authentication or permission was rejected. Check your credential and destination; no fallback or automatic retry.
Crash.ConnectionFailed: The service could not complete the request. No fallback or automatic retry.
Crash.SecretStoreUnsupported: This OS credential store is not supported on this platform.
Crash.RepositoryUnavailable: The repository could not be verified as available for issue creation.
Crash.ResultUnknown: The response could not be verified. Check the tracker before retrying.
Crash.ProviderDisabled: The selected provider is no longer enabled. Select and check an enabled provider explicitly.
Crash.ConsentRequired: Check the destination, then explicitly consent. Changes invalidate confirmation.
Crash.DuplicateWarning: A prior send may already have reached the service, even if cancelled or failed. Check the tracker manually before retrying. The draft is retained; no automatic retry.
Crash.AlreadySent: This draft is marked sent. It cannot be sent again here. You may delete the local copy.
Crash.InvalidDestination: The provider did not return a valid HTTPS destination and explicit visibility.
Crash.Cancelled: Operation cancelled or timed out. No automatic retry.
Crash.Failed: The operation failed. Provider details were suppressed to avoid exposing credentials or local data.
Crash.Busy: An operation is already in progress.
